'''Colin Bruce''' is a British author and [[physicist]]. He has written many scientific works, including non-fiction, but he is most well known for his [[popular science]] stories. He is an expert in mathematical paradoxes and a lover of mysteries.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.randomhouse.co.uk/authors/colin-bruce|title=About us}}</ref> Living in Oxford,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.randomhouse.co.uk/authors/colin-bruce|title=About us}}</ref> he frequently contributes to university life through giving talks at the Oxford University Physics Society and [[Oxford University Scientific Society]], and attending various events.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://talks.ox.ac.uk/talk/index/8064|title = Talks – Oxford Talks}}</ref>

==Selected works==
* ''[[The Strange Case of Mrs Hudson's Cat]]''<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.randomhouse.co.uk/authors/colin-bruce|title=About us}}</ref>
* ''Conned Again, Watson: Cautionary Tales of Logic, Math and Probability''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/Colin-Bruce/e/B000APJSD0|title = Colin Bruce|website = Amazon UK}}</ref>
* ''Schrödinger's Rabbits: The Many Worlds of Quantum''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/Colin-Bruce/e/B000APJSD0|title = Colin Bruce|website = Amazon UK}}</ref>
